how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-desolace-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:261:obj:0: Destroy 30 Undead Ravagers, then return to Brother Anton at Nijel's Point.
rows.quest:261:details:0: I will be frank. We are at war with the Scourge. It is an evil that corrupts our people and infects our land. It must be stopped before it overwhelms us and drags our world into shadow. We of the ⟦E1⟧ have sworn to fight the Scourge with body and soul.
rows.quest:261:details:1: BIf you are with us, then gather your courage and prove your allegiance--destroy the undead ravagers of ⟦E2⟧, in the ⟦E3⟧ to the south.
rows.quest:261:details:2: BDo this, and the Crusade will embrace you.
rows.quest:261:completion:0: You have proven your resolve, and the ⟦E1⟧ commends you.
rows.quest:261:completion:1: BIf you do not shy from righteous slaughter, then perhaps your path lies with us...
rows.quest:1052:obj:0: Take Brother Anton's Letter of Commendation to Raleigh the Devout in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1052:details:0: We of the ⟦E1⟧ lay claim to strongholds from Hearthglen to ⟦E5⟧. We are quite proud of our bastions of cleansing throughout Lordaeron.
rows.quest:1052:details:1: BYou have proven yourself against the undead in ⟦E2⟧. But the true threat of the plague lies in Lordaeron.
rows.quest:1052:details:2: BTravel to the town of ⟦E4⟧, in the ⟦E6⟧. Seek out a crusader named Raleigh the Devout. Give him this letter of commendation bearing my seal and he will escort you to a place of honor in our ⟦E7⟧ Monastery.
rows.quest:1052:completion:0: Brother Anton still spreads the word of the ⟦E1⟧? Oh my....
rows.quest:1361:details:0: A warrior of the ⟦E8⟧, Regthar Deathgate, is recruiting agents for a mission into the land of ⟦E2⟧. Speak with him if you wish to volunteer. He is stationed in the ⟦E9⟧, in a series of bunkers west of the Crossroads.
rows.quest:1361:details:1: BAnd sharpen your weapons. ⟦E2⟧ is a place torn by war.
rows.quest:1361:completion:0: Yes, I am recruiting. This mission leads into ⟦E2⟧, against the centaur there. I will be brief so that you may quickly begin.
rows.quest:1362:obj:0: Speak with Felgur Twocuts at Ghost Walker Post in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1362:details:0: The Kolkar centaur live in ⟦E2⟧, and their forces have spread into the ⟦E9⟧. This is a known fact and we have ⟦E8⟧ agents dealing with them here.
rows.quest:1362:details:1: BBut as long as the centaur are strong in ⟦E2⟧, they will always pose a threat. It is time we rid ourselves of that threat.
rows.quest:1362:details:2: BSpeak with Felgur Twocuts at Ghost Walker Post in ⟦E2⟧. He was sent to gather intelligence on the centaur. He will know how to best deal with the Kolkar of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1362:completion:0: You are here on orders from Regthar? Then you are here to deal with the centaur. Good.
rows.quest:1362:completion:1: BI hope you're rested. I don't know how our campaign against the centaur will end, but I know the struggle will be long.
rows.quest:1365:obj:0: Bring Khan Dez'hepah's Head to Felgur Twocuts in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1365:details:0: The Kolkar are not the only centaur of ⟦E2⟧. Many clans wander these dry plains, fighting and dying against each other. And it is good that they fight among themselves, for they are strong and brutal. If the centaur united against us, they would be a fierce foe.
rows.quest:1365:details:1: BWe must deal with them before they unite.
rows.quest:1365:details:2: BYour first task is to disrupt the Kolkar clan. Do this by killing its leader, Khan Dez'hepah.
rows.quest:1365:details:3: BThe Kolkar Village is northeast of here. Go, and may fortune go with you.
rows.quest:1365:completion:0: Well done. This swift act against the Kolkar is an effective show of strength, and strength is what the centaur understand best.
rows.quest:1365:completion:1: BThe death of the Kolkar leader will not only disrupt that clan, but give pause to the others.
rows.quest:1366:obj:0: Bring 15 Centaur Ears to Felgur Twocuts in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1366:details:0: Now that you scared the centaur clans, it's time to bleed them. When traveling ⟦E2⟧, hunt centaur. I don't care which clan you hunt. Just gather ears. A hoard of ears.
rows.quest:1366:details:1: BBy weakening their numbers you will weaken their resolve, and stamp out any thoughts of expansion.
rows.quest:1366:completion:0: By now, the centaur must know your name. I'm sure they know it, and respect it, and fear it. And just as they know you, they know the banner under which you ride.
rows.quest:1367:obj:0: Gain a Friendly reputation with the Magram, then speak with Warug.
rows.quest:1367:details:0: To beat the centaur, we must use their hatred against them. We will ally with one of the clans and through them, we will learn how to defeat all the clans.
rows.quest:1367:details:1: BIf you choose to ally with the Magram then slay their foes, the Gelkis. This will earn you respect among the Magram. When you earn enough, then meet with the Magram spokesman Warug, on the outskirts of the Magram Village, in southeast ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1367:completion:0: The Gelkis cry when they hear your name, ⟦2⟧. They fear you and they hate you. They hate you like they hate the Magram!
rows.quest:1367:completion:1: BMaybe you are strong like the Magram. We will see...
rows.quest:1368:obj:0: Gain a Friendly reputation with the Gelkis, then speak with Uthek the Wise.
rows.quest:1368:details:0: To beat the centaur, we must use their hatred against them. We will ally with one of the clans and through them, we will learn how to defeat all the clans.
rows.quest:1368:details:1: BIf you choose to ally with the Gelkis then slay their most hated rival, the Magram. After you earn the respect of the Gelkis, meet with the Gelkis shaman Uthek the Wise, on the outskirts of the Gelkis Village, in southwest ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1368:completion:0: The earth speaks to me. And it says you have killed many Magram. This is good.
rows.quest:1368:completion:1: BIf you are a friend of the Gelkis, then listen. I have more tasks for you.
rows.quest:1369:obj:0: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 3 Broken Tears to Warug in the Magram Village.
rows.quest:1369:details:0: The Gelkis think our centaur mother, ⟦E10⟧, protects us. They are stupid. No one protects the centaur. The Magram do not need protection! We are the strongest!
rows.quest:1369:details:1: BShow the Gelkis they are stupid. Go to the cave in their village. They hoard crystals in that cave, the tears of ⟦E10⟧. Destroy the tears and bring me the broken pieces!
rows.quest:1369:completion:0: You got the tears! Now the Gelkis will know that ⟦E10⟧ will not help them. She will not cry when we crush them! The Magram will rule!
rows.quest:1369:completion:1: BYou are smart to help us, ⟦3⟧. We are the strongest.
rows.quest:1370:obj:0: Bring 6 bags of Crudely Dried Meat to Uthek the Wise in the Gelkis Village.
rows.quest:1370:details:0: When we are not at war, we hunt for meat. Meat gives us strength, and full bellies fight harder than empty ones.
rows.quest:1370:details:1: BIt is the same with the Magram. They store extra meat so they may fight longer between hunts. If you raid their village to the east and take their stores of meat, then their strength will fail.
rows.quest:1370:completion:0: Good. I can hear the loud Magram bellies grumble from their village, far away!
rows.quest:1370:completion:1: BI will give this meat to the Gelkis. And we will fight for many days without rest.
rows.quest:1370:completion:2: BWhat you did is good for the Gelkis, ⟦4⟧.
rows.quest:1371:obj:0: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring an Advanced Target Dummy to Warug in the Magram Village in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1371:details:0: Long ago, a little gnome came to ⟦E2⟧. He had horses and a cart, and the cart held strange things. Funny things. Things that burned different colors. Things that moved and weren't alive. I killed the little gnome, but before that... he made me laugh.
rows.quest:1371:details:1: BI kept my favorite thing from his cart. It was a human made of wood and it waved at me until I hit it and broke it.
rows.quest:1371:details:2: BI want a new one. Get me a new one!
rows.quest:1371:completion:0: Yes, this is what I had! I will make it move again. It makes me laugh!
rows.quest:1373:obj:0: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a Draenethyst Shard to Uthek the Wise in the Gelkis Village in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1373:details:0: You have more to prove, and your next task will take you far, so for now the Gelkis will fight the Magram without you.
rows.quest:1373:details:1: BThe earth whispers many secrets to those who listen. One secret I hear is of a red crystal. It is called draenethyst, and it is new to our earth. It comes from a place where mountains fly, and where demons rule.
rows.quest:1373:details:2: BBring me a shard of draenethyst, and it will make my magic strong! The shard is in a place called the ⟦E11⟧, held by the lost one Ongeku.
rows.quest:1373:completion:0: Yes, this is the shard of which the earth whispered. I can feel strong magic in it! I will use this magic against the enemies of the Gelkis.
rows.quest:1373:completion:1: BYou have done one more task for us, ⟦5⟧. Maybe soon, we will call you friend.
rows.quest:1374:obj:0: Bring the Khan Jehn's Head to Uthek the Wise in the Gelkis Village in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1374:details:0: The earth speaks to me, and it says that the Magram grow weak. Now it is time to kill their Khan!
rows.quest:1374:details:1: BBring me the head of the Magram Khan, Jehn!
rows.quest:1374:completion:0: Khan Jehn was strong, but stupid. He thought his own strength was great. He did not see that earth magic is stronger. The Magram centaur will now fall without their leader, and the Gelkis will one day rule!
rows.quest:1375:obj:0: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring the Head of Khan Shaka to Warug in the Magram Village in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1375:details:0: You help the Magram, and I like you. Now, kill the Khan of the Gelkis! He is Khan Shaka, and I want his head! I want to stare at his head and laugh at him!
rows.quest:1375:completion:0: Khan Shaka is dead! I will place his head on a pike, and keep it with me so Shaka can see the strength of the Magram!
rows.quest:1380:obj:0: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Uthek the Wise in the Gelkis Village.
rows.quest:1380:details:0: ⟦6⟧, you helped us against the Magram. Now, help us beat the Maraudine! Kill the head of their clan, Khan Hratha!
rows.quest:1380:details:1: BTo face him, blow the Maraudine War Horn. It is atop a high bluff in the Valley of Spears.
rows.quest:1380:details:2: BBut to blow the horn, you must gain a warhorn mouthpiece. These are rare, carried only by trusted Maraudine centaur.
rows.quest:1380:details:3: BAfter the horn is blown, centaur will come. Kill them until Hratha appears.
rows.quest:1380:details:4: BKhan Hratha holds the piece of... a key. Bring it to me...
rows.quest:1380:completion:0: He is dead! Khan Hratha is dead! And now the Maraudine will fall! When the Gelkis rule this land, ⟦7⟧, we will remember you. And the spirits of the earth will sing your name for all time.
rows.quest:1381:obj:0: Maintain your Magram reputation, and bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Warug in the Magram Village in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1381:details:0: The Gelkis Khan is dead, and now the Maraudine will fall! Kill the Maraudine Khan, Hratha!
rows.quest:1381:details:1: BTo face him, blow the horn on the high bluff in the Valley of Spears. But to blow the horn, you need a mouthpiece. To get a mouthpiece, kill Maraudine centaur. Keep killing until you find a mouthpiece. Then blow the horn.
rows.quest:1381:details:2: BDo this and Maraudine centaur will come to the tower. Kill them until Khan Hratha appears. Hratha holds the piece of a key. Give this piece to me...
rows.quest:1381:completion:0: Khan Hratha is dead! Now the Magram are the strongest of the centaur! We will crush the others, and rule ⟦E2⟧!
rows.quest:1381:completion:1: BWe will remember, you, ⟦8⟧, and you will be spared our hooves when all others are trampled.
rows.quest:1382:obj:0: Gain a Friendly reputation with the Gelkis, then speak with Uthek the Wise.
rows.quest:1382:details:0: We are fortunate the centaur clans fight among themselves, for if they joined into a single force then they would be unstoppable. Yes, we are fortunate, and we should press our advantage.
rows.quest:1382:details:1: BOne of the centaur clans, the Gelkis clan, is in brutal war with the Magram clan. If we attack the Magram, then perhaps an alliance may be struck with the Gelkis.
rows.quest:1382:details:2: BSpeak with Uthek the Wise, in the outskirts of the Gelkis camps in southwestern ⟦E2⟧. Through her we might strike an alliance with the Gelkis.
rows.quest:1382:completion:0: Your name is whispered among the Gelkis. You have much Magram blood on your hands. This is good.
rows.quest:1382:completion:1: BMaybe it is also good if we speak. Speak of what you can do for the Gelkis, and what we can do for you.
rows.quest:1384:obj:0: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring 10 Crude Charms to Uthek the Wise in the Gelkis Village in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1384:details:0: The Kolkar centaurs think their magic is strong. They do not know magic! They would not know magic if it bit them!
rows.quest:1384:details:1: BYou will show them their magic is weak. Go to the Kolkar to the northeast and kill them. Take their charms. Bring me the charms and I will throw them in the fire and laugh!
rows.quest:1384:completion:0: You do a good thing for the Gelkis. The Kolkar are weak and will die. Their magic is pathetic and will not save them. You showed them this, and their fear will make them even more feeble!
rows.quest:1384:completion:1: BAnd in our lands, the feeble soon die.
rows.quest:1385:obj:0: Gain a Friendly reputation with the Magram, then speak with Warug.
rows.quest:1385:details:0: ⟦E2⟧ is a land at war. The centaurs wage war with each other, and we believe the victor among them will spill out and threaten our strongholds. That, we cannot allow
rows.quest:1385:details:1: BWe must learn how to beat the centaurs, and to do that... we must ally with one of the clans. The Magram centaurs war with the Gelkis. If you fight the Gelkis then the Magram might consider an alliance.
rows.quest:1385:details:2: BEarn the favor of the Magrams then speak with Warug, in the Magram village in southeastern ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1385:completion:0: Many Gelkis fall to you. I like that. Maybe you can do more things I like. Maybe you and the Magram can be friends.
rows.quest:1386:obj:0: Maintain your reputation with the Magram. Kill 12 Kolkar Centaurs, 12 Kolkar Scouts and 6 Kolkar Maulers, then return to Warug in the Magram Village in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1386:details:0: The Kolkar think they are strong, but we laugh at them! We laugh and we kill them! You kill them too. Show me you can kill Kolkar like we do. Head north and slay them all!
rows.quest:1386:completion:0: The Kolkar fear you now! I hope you laughed when you killed them. It is better to laugh when you kill, so the enemy can see he is weak.
rows.quest:1387:obj:0: Bring 15 Centaur Ears to Corporal Melkins at Nijel's Point in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1387:details:0: Many clans make up the centaur race. Each has its own leader and agenda, but all the clans have one thing in common. Cruelty.
rows.quest:1387:details:1: BIf we are to ever find peace, then the centaurs must be removed. And so I put you on the task to do just that.
rows.quest:1387:details:2: BWhile wandering ⟦E2⟧, hunt centaur and take their ears. Bring me many, many ears.
rows.quest:1387:details:3: BDo this in service of the ⟦E12⟧, ⟦9⟧, and we will be one step closer to war's end.
rows.quest:1387:completion:1: BYour service to the ⟦E12⟧ is unquestioned, ⟦10⟧. The blood you spilled in ⟦E2⟧ will, no doubt, save countless lives.
rows.quest:1437:obj:0: Find and search Tyranis and Dalinda Malem's wagon in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1437:details:0: I am Vahlarriel, ⟦11⟧. I've come here to discover the whereabouts of two missing nobles of a Darnassian merchant family--House Malem. The father of the house fears the worst, and I am to do everything I can to find his missing children. I have yet to start my search for Tyranis or Dalinda, but I am hopeful I shall not be here long.
rows.quest:1437:details:1: BLast word tells of them passing through the ⟦E13⟧ a few weeks ago.
rows.quest:1437:details:2: BIf you find their wagon, please, come find me immediately.
rows.quest:1437:completion:0: As you rummage around the remains of the wagon, it becomes obvious that it was attacked by both spells and weapons. The battle seemed one-sided and quick; there's no blood to be found, and no remains of any bodies.
rows.quest:1437:completion:1: BWhoever attacked the wagon was efficient and swift.
rows.quest:1438:details:0: Find both Dalinda and Tyranis if you can and come back to me with your findings. Start your search at this fortress. I will contact my superiors in ⟦E14⟧ immediately and let them know the situation.
rows.quest:1438:details:1: B⟦12⟧, there is something else I wish to impress upon you. My superiors have shown some concern over Tyranis' and his motives for coming here. It is more important to them that Dalinda is found and brought back safely. Tyranis is to be... gauged before he is taken home.
rows.quest:1438:completion:0: Thank ⟦E15⟧ someone has finally come to help. Please, ⟦13⟧, I need your help. My brother Tyranis and I were captured and brought here by the Burning Blade. I think they mean to sacrifice me to their demon masters!
rows.quest:1438:completion:1: BI knew coming to ⟦E2⟧ was a mistake, but Tyranis has recently begun craving knowledge of all things arcane--even against the wishes of our people. He decided to make this trek even after hearing tales of this land's demon infestation.
rows.quest:1438:completion:2: BI fear the worst for him.
rows.quest:1439:details:0: We were brought here after the orcs slaughtered all our guards and servants. Oh, the terrible things they did to them! I thought surely they would kill us right there and then, but it became obvious they had other plans.
rows.quest:1439:details:1: BTyranis attempted to speak to them. I think he wanted to impress them with his knowledge of the arcane... I'm not sure why.
rows.quest:1439:details:2: BPlease, I can't leave here until I know what's happened to my brother. Find him, then come back for me when his fate is known.
rows.quest:1439:completion:0: This is terrible! But I suppose it was necessary. If it wasn't by your hand, it would have surely been by that of my people's. I suppose I should thank you--please forgive me if it doesn't seem sincere. I mean no offense.
rows.quest:1439:completion:1: BWith the knowledge of my brother's fate in hand, it seems the time for my escape has come. If you are still willing, I will accept your aid in escaping this horrible place.
rows.quest:1439:completion:2: BWhen you are ready, we can make our way to safety.
rows.quest:1440:obj:0: Escort Dalinda Malem from Thunder Axe Fortress and then return to Vahlarriel Demonslayer in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1440:details:0: So, the time is now then? I appreciate your efforts, and if the situation does not lend itself, then allow me to thank you now for everything you've done for me and my family. If you're ready, then there is nothing else for me here--we can leave when you feel the time is right.
rows.quest:1440:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦14⟧. Dalinda made it safely back here to Nijel's Point, and in much better condition than I could have asked for. The fact that she arrived here under her own power was a good sign. I hope you're well?
rows.quest:1440:completion:1: BIt pains me to know that both Tyranis and Dalinda didn't return, but the embarrassment of Tyranis' decisions is hers to endure. It is something she will have to deal with when she returns to ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:1454:details:0: My first order of business is for the mage Karnitol--a noble of some sort in ⟦E16⟧. Seems his ship was attacked by sea giants while off the coast in the northwest of ⟦E2⟧. He and his servants tried to bring one of his more valuable chests ashore, but when the sea giants attacked in droves, he chose to abandon it and teleport himself and his servants to safety.
rows.quest:1454:details:1: BHe wants us to find the chest and its contents, and return it to him in ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:1454:completion:0: You notice the chest does not seem to have any water damage.
rows.quest:1454:completion:1: BThe second thing you notice is that the top has been forced open, and whatever magical traps were set to safeguard it have long been triggered--this much is obvious from the burn marks around its edges.
rows.quest:1455:details:0: You take a few moments to figure out what pried the chest open, and you notice along the sides and top of the chest, long, deep scratches that reveal that something other than a man or giant took interest in it. The marks don't appear as if they were caused by dagger or sword.
rows.quest:1455:details:1: BAfter going through the chest you find it to be completely empty.
rows.quest:1455:details:2: BNot having another course of action, you close the chest and prepare to leave. Kreldig will be disappointed.
rows.quest:1455:completion:0: Welcome back to Nijel's Point, ⟦15⟧. So, tell me what you found.
rows.quest:1455:completion:1: BWhat!? Nothing? An empty chest ain't gonna get us paid, I'm afraid.
rows.quest:1455:completion:2: BTell me more about these marks you saw... these slashes.
rows.quest:1456:obj:0: Find Karnitol's Satchel and return it to Kreldig Ungor in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1456:details:1: BWell, we might not be without hope quite yet.
rows.quest:1456:details:2: BAlong that same coast, but to the north near Ranazjar Isle, there're night elf ruins at the bottom of the ocean. A tribe of naga, the Slitherblade, make that their home. I think that'd be our best bet.
rows.quest:1456:details:3: BIf a scouting party went that far south, then they must've been pretty powerful. If you're gonna find Karnitol's belongings, I'd start with the more powerful naga: the tidehunters or sea witches.
rows.quest:1456:completion:0: This is great, ⟦16⟧! You found Karnitol's belongings!
rows.quest:1456:completion:1: BThose blasted naga, always causing trouble. I think I'd rather spend my life at war with the ⟦E8⟧ than have to go against their kind. You've done a great service to the Reclaimers.
rows.quest:1457:obj:0: Bring Karnitol's Satchel to Roetten Stonehammer in ⟦E17⟧.
rows.quest:1457:details:0: Take Karnitol's things back to Roetten in ⟦E17⟧ and he'll pay you for a job well done.
rows.quest:1457:details:1: BHaha, if you're not careful, he's gonna be so pleased with ya that he'll ask you to join us full time.
rows.quest:1457:details:3: BBe careful on your way back, and don't take too much time--Karnitol's not the most of patient of men, but he's very generous nonetheless.
rows.quest:1457:completion:0: Ah, the Karnitol business in ⟦E2⟧. Excellent!
rows.quest:1457:completion:1: BSo, the chest was destroyed, but the items are all here, huh? Well, I'll let him be the judge of that. One good part about this business I got going on here is that if they're not satisfied, I can tell 'em to shove it! They're relyin' on us to find their stuff... not make sure it's all pretty and in good shape when they get it back.
rows.quest:1457:completion:2: BGood work, ⟦18⟧. Let's see about gettin' you paid.
rows.quest:1458:obj:0: Bring 10 Hatefury Claws, and 10 Hatefury Horns to Kreldig Ungor in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1458:details:0: One of my tasks out here involves picking up some reagents for Leftwitch, a gnome mage in Kharanos . Roetten seems to think it's easy coin in the bank since we're out here already. He doesn't really care that we're short-handed as is.
rows.quest:1458:details:1: BThe first few items on his list should be easy enough to get, and it'd be a good chunk of coin for anyone helping me out.
rows.quest:1458:details:2: BI need some horns and claws from the Hatefury satyr to the east of here. Bring 'em back to me and we'll get started on the rest of the list.
rows.quest:1458:completion:0: Good good, ⟦19⟧. Not sure if these are of any good quality, but if Leftwitch wanted a specific type, he should have specified before sending the Reclaimers out here to begin with.
rows.quest:1458:completion:1: BWhat say you to getting on with the next item on his list?
rows.quest:1459:obj:0: Bring 7 vials of Scorpashi Venom and 3 Aged Kodo Hides to Kreldig Ungor in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1459:details:0: Next on Leftwitch's list is... let's see... hmm. Oh, here it is.
rows.quest:1459:details:1: BSimple enough, but pretty explicit in his directions. He needs venom from the scorpashi, and hide from some kodo. The fine print says both are from specific creatures: the venom's got to come from any of the scorpashi, and the hide's got to come from an aged kodo, not the dying or ancient ones.
rows.quest:1459:details:2: BMages, I tell ya, some of the stuff they want... it's just weird.
rows.quest:1459:completion:0: Your help here's a boon, ⟦20⟧. You're cutting my time spent here in ⟦E2⟧ by half at least. I'll be back in ⟦E17⟧ warming my feet in no time with your help.
rows.quest:1459:completion:1: BWhen we get this list taken care of, and I'm back home, look me up, I'll buy you an ale for sure.
rows.quest:1459:completion:2: BBut until then, let's get the rest of these reagents gathered.
rows.quest:1465:obj:0: Return the Malem Pendant to Vahlarriel Demonslayer in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1465:details:0: As you continue your search of the wagon you find not only a pendant, but also footprints leading off towards the south. In the distance you can see smoke rising from a large fort. The smoke is from a kept fire, not the burning of buildings, and your instincts tell you that the Malems, if still alive, were taken that direction.
rows.quest:1465:details:1: BYou think Vahlarriel at Nijel's Point should not only see the pendant you've found, but also know about the signs of life to the south.
rows.quest:1465:completion:1: BThe two of them were warned about how dangerous coming here would be. Now they're both missing... or worse.
rows.quest:1465:completion:2: BYou said you saw tracks heading to a fort nearby? That may be our best bet.
rows.quest:1465:completion:3: BFrom what the locals have said, that fortress is infested with members of the Burning Blade--orcs who have dedicated themselves to demon causes. They may not represent the majority of the ⟦E8⟧'s beliefs, but they are evil and will slay you on sight if you're caught spying.
rows.quest:1466:obj:0: Bring 10 Felhound Brains, 10 Nether Wings, and 10 vials of Doomwarder Blood to Kreldig Ungor in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1466:details:0: This is the last of the items, and I won't lie, it ain't pretty. I'm also expecting this to take you a little bit longer than the other items.
rows.quest:1466:details:1: BSo, enough with the warning, let's get this started. Leftwitch says he needs: ten brains from either mana eaters, mage hunters, or ley hunters. Ten nether wings from a nether maiden, sister or sorceress. And... ten vials of doomwarder blood from a doomwarder captain, or lord.
rows.quest:1466:details:2: BSimple enough, huh? Sheesh... if you wanna pass on this one, I'd understand.
rows.quest:1466:completion:0: Honestly? I wouldn't have thought it. You're amazing, ⟦21⟧. Taking on demons for a mage's experiments, and coming back in one piece to boot. Great job!
rows.quest:1466:completion:1: BI'm personally gonna tell Roetten about you when I get back to ⟦E17⟧.
rows.quest:1467:obj:0: Bring Leftwitch's Package back to Roetten Stonehammer in ⟦E17⟧.
rows.quest:1467:details:0: To get paid, you're gonna have to get back to ⟦E17⟧ and speak to Roetten himself. He'll love getting Leftwitch's package out of the way anyway. Just give him this and it should be enough to get your booty.
rows.quest:1467:details:1: BAnd don't worry, I'm still going to put in a good word for you when I get back. I shouldn't be in ⟦E2⟧ much longer.
rows.quest:1467:completion:0: Ah, the package for Leftwitch from ⟦E2⟧. Excellent. I 'preciate the work, and your timeliness, ⟦22⟧. Glad to have you aboard for at least this small bit of work.
rows.quest:1467:completion:1: BI got your payment right here. Let it be known that Reclaimers Inc. always pays well for a hard week's work.
rows.quest:1480:obj:0: Bring the Flayed ⟦E18⟧ to Maurin Bonesplitter in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1480:details:0: The torn skin smells rotten, and is remarkably pliable for something that appears to be dry and fragile.
rows.quest:1480:details:1: BAs you unroll it, you can clearly see the red markings of some kind of language on one side. At the bottom of the skin is a very clear symbol that you guess is a signature of some kind.
rows.quest:1480:details:2: BPerhaps it is something Maurin could tell you more about?
rows.quest:1480:completion:0: Hmm, these runes are indeed a language, ⟦23⟧, an old language. They seem remotely similar to the Eredun language, but the differences are drastic. If I am not mistaken, this is a contract of some kind.... Here, yes, this symbol is the demon's signature: Lord Azrethoc.
rows.quest:1481:obj:0: Bring a Shadowstalker Scalp to Maurin Bonesplitter in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1481:details:0: I believe I can find this demon lord given the proper reagents.
rows.quest:1481:details:1: BIf he is indeed as powerful as I suspect, I will need items gathered from deadly creatures. But you act in the Warchief's name, so I am sure you will accept my task.
rows.quest:1481:details:2: BFirst, I will have to break any wards he has against scrying. For this, I will need the scalp from a satyr--but not any satyr. The scalp must come from a Hatefury shadowstalker.
rows.quest:1481:details:3: BSearch for them among the ancient ruins in the northeast of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1481:completion:0: The shadowstalkers were unable to slay you, ⟦24⟧. Impressive... most impressive.
rows.quest:1481:completion:1: BThis scalp will do nicely for my spell. While you were away, I was able to gather some of the other reagents needed for the spell.
rows.quest:1481:completion:2: BI am almost ready. I only need a focus for the spell--something to project an image of the demon lord and his whereabouts.
rows.quest:1482:obj:0: Bring an Oracle Crystal to Maurin Bonesplitter in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1482:details:0: An oracle crystal would do nicely. They are crafted by the naga for their oracles to use.
rows.quest:1482:details:1: BNorthwest of here, along the coast, is a vast coral reef that the naga have taken as their home when this close to the shore. You can find their oracles there. The Slitherblade are deadly and will not react kindly to your intrusions, so be careful and make haste.
rows.quest:1482:details:2: BWhen you return, we shall see about finding this demon lord Azrethoc.
rows.quest:1482:completion:0: A precious oracle crystal... flawless... beautiful. Indeed.
rows.quest:1482:completion:1: BWe shall begin immediately. Finding this demon lord should be our primary concern, and its slaying demands our utmost attention.
rows.quest:1482:completion:2: BTake a step back, ⟦25⟧, and let us see what this demon is, and where he may be found.
rows.quest:1484:details:0: This creature is far more dangerous than I had anticipated. No doubt Takata questions my abilities to take on such a creature, and it would insult his honor if he were not informed about what just happened.
rows.quest:1484:details:1: BSpeak to the swordsman, tell him you are willing to slay the demon if he would allow it, but do not press too hard. It is better if he thinks it his own idea.
rows.quest:1484:completion:0: I witnessed what just occurred with Maurin and the demon lord. That creature, even as an apparition, seems to have more power than my warlock companion. I wonder if he's up to the task of defeating the monster? It would serve the Warchief better if I go myself, but with my responsibilities here, I would disgrace my clan if I turned my back on my duties here to battle this evil for my own honor.
rows.quest:1488:obj:0: Slay Lord Azrethoc and Jugkar Grim'rod and return to Takata Steelblade in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1488:details:0: Although I have no knowledge of this Lord Azrethoc, I agree with Maurin, he must be stopped; especially if he is attempting to gain influence over the Burning Blade to further his goals.
rows.quest:1488:details:1: BYou have already shown you wish to aid the Warchief, and I would trust you to gather a party to slay the demon lord and his warlock servant.
rows.quest:1488:details:2: BWhen you are ready, head directly south, and return to me when the threat has been ended.
rows.quest:1488:completion:0: A mighty victory for us all, ⟦26⟧. Let us rejoice in your success. I trust now that our future here is not as bleak as I once thought.
rows.quest:1488:completion:1: BThe demons will be slain, the Burning Blade will fail in their efforts, and we may one day have a place we can safely call home again.
rows.quest:5381:obj:0: Retrieve the Demon Box from Thunder Axe Fortress, and return it, along with the Demon Pick to Taiga Wisemane in Shadowprey Village.⟦27⟧
rows.quest:5381:details:0: The Burning Blade possesses the Demon Box. Within it lies the powerful Hand of Iruxos. The Burning Blade uses it to open demonic portals at Mannoroc Coven. We must stop the tide of demons entering our world, ⟦28⟧!
rows.quest:5381:details:1: BUse this demon pick on the red crystal in Thunder Axe Fortress to gain access to the Demon Box.⟦29⟧
rows.quest:5381:completion:0: Ah, the Demon Box. Give it to me, ⟦30⟧, and I shall open... and thus reveal to you the Hand of Iruxos.
